headline: Frostburg State end West Liberty's perfect run
dek: West Liberty had won all four of their matches until they went to Frostburg State and lost without scoring. Frostburg State and Davis & Elkins are now the only unbeaten programmes left, and between them they have drawn three of the eleven matches they have played.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Charleston have scored more than Frostburg State and Davis & Elkins together, and twelve different players have contributed to their twenty-four; the scoring is spread, not carried.

wire.line: Charleston scored ten in a single match against West Virginia Wesleyan, more than Wesleyan have scored all season.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Frostburg State are unbeaten after six matches and have conceded four goals in them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Josiah Emerson has made nineteen saves in Frostburg State's goal and been beaten three times.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: West Virginia Wesleyan have lost all six of their matches, and have scored three goals while conceding twenty-three.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Jon-Michael Gordon has four goals for Wheeling from fourteen shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: One match is past its date with no result published, and it is West Virginia Wesleyan's.

last_match.line: Wheeling's first win since August; they have still lost every conference match they have played.

next_match.line: Davis & Elkins are unbeaten; West Liberty's only defeat came against the conference's other unbeaten side.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
